root_cause.summary: Loader was authored against v6 JSON schema (22 top-level keys). On 2026-04-18 a c2-v1 minimal runtime-gate JSON (4 keys) was created at the loader's preferred path. Loader's _DATA[k] hard-fail accesses then crashed for the 9 v6-only keys absent in c2-v1.
root_cause.carveout_purpose: AN11 compliance — c2-v1 holds only pure pass/score laws (no system_prompt-injection); 14 runtime-gate laws on top of 16D alm_phi_vec_logger_v1 schema.

fix.description: Hard-fail preserved for psi_constants + laws (real bugs); .get() defaults for 9 v6-only sections; explicit SCHEMA_VERSION + V6_ONLY_KEYS_AVAILABLE constants exposed to consumers.

rejected_alternatives.option_a_restore_keys_to_pruned_json: Violates the deliberate AN11 carve-out semantics. The 9 keys are intentionally absent in c2-v1; restoring them would re-introduce non-AN11-compliant content into the runtime gate.
rejected_alternatives.option_b_silent_get_everywhere: Current ubu1 .bak band-aid. Hides intent; future refactors might re-introduce hard-fails. No way for consumers to detect schema.

fix.lines_changed: ~30 lines (added schema detection block + v6-only section header + required-keys hard-fail block; converted 9 _DATA[k] to _DATA.get(k, {}))
fix.consumers_unaffected: All 30+ modules importing PSI_*/LAWS/PSI_F_CRITICAL still work — those keys exist in both schemas.

honest_c3_raw10.loader_robustness_vs_spec_strictness_tra: The schema-aware loader trades strict-fail-on-missing-key for tolerant defaults. This means a future BUG that accidentally drops sigma6 from v6 would silently degrade to empty dict instead of raising. Mitigation: SCHEMA_VERSION + V6_ONLY_KEYS_AVAILABLE flags let consumers assert their schema requirements. Stronger mitigation would be a runtime _SCHEMA_REQUIREMENTS table per import context, but that's overengineering for current consumer set.
honest_c3_raw10.key_restoration_source_confidence: We did NOT restore any keys. We confirmed via _meta inspection that c2-v1 is an intentional 2026-04-18 minimal subset (description: 'AN11-compliant: laws OBSERVE and classify; they do NOT system_prompt-inject behavior'). The full v6 corpus still exists at ~/anima/config/consciousness_laws.json (351KB) for any module that explicitly needs it. Confidence: HIGH on intent (explicit _meta description); MEDIUM on whether all 9 keys are truly dormant (no consumer in current grep imports them, but cross-module search via attribute reflection was not performed).
honest_c3_raw10.side_effect_risk: Risk of breaking dependent modules: LOW. Grep across ~/anima/anima/{tools,src} shows all consciousness_laws imports use PSI_*/LAWS/get_law()/PSI_F_CRITICAL — all present in both schemas. Modules that previously crashed at import time (chain through conscious_decoder) now succeed. No module observed to read from SIGMA6/FORMULAS/etc. directly. Residual risk: dynamic dict() iteration over CONSTRAINTS in some untested code path could see fewer entries, but no module in PSI ecosystem scans CONSTRAINTS dynamically per current grep.
